children.text: Why can’t we change the world?

This is our first time writing to you & what feels like forever. It has been a long road leading to this point. Through the trials, tribulations, joys, lessons, achievements, and losses, we have amassed a vault of thoughts. These thoughts & experiences are our Biased Opinions. Not necessarily wrong, not necessarily right, but our opinions live in the facts of it all.  Let’s see where life takes us.

That leads me to my first question. Why can’t we change the world? Granted, that’s exactly what we intend to do. Through thought, discourse, and action, the world we know will become the world we aspire. However, in today’s time, with the propaganda, divisiveness, and fear-mongering, hope in change seems  like a futile effort. I’m sure you are just as tired as I am. So, if everyone is tired, why can’t we change the world?

Now you hear me mention “we” quite often. I say we because this brand was not just built by me and it has not gotten to this point through just me. There is a community that has built us. There is a community that believed even when we thought it all worthless. Those days we felt unheard, people asked to hear. Those days we felt unseen, people wanted to see. Those days we chose to give up, our community wanted us to keep going. So I ask, how will we change the world? We will. Welcome to the Family, Seize the Day!
